props.description: Set on Stepper.Root. Layout axis. Default 'vertical'. 'horizontal' is scoped to a flat list of top-level Steps — StepGroup/nested Steps assume vertical trunk-and-branch geometry (see stepper-group.tsx's DOM-measured connector math) and are not supported in horizontal mode. See README.md.

props.name: showStepBadge
props.description: Set on Stepper.StepGroup or Stepper.Step. When true, renders a "Step {n}/{total}" pill badge next to the group title. Default false — purely opt-in, no rendering change for existing consumers that don't pass it.

props.name: totalStepsOverride
props.description: Set on Stepper.StepGroup or Stepper.Step. Lets a non-flat-mode consumer supply the flow's real step-group count instead of the currently-registered count (see StepperStepProps.totalStepsOverride for the flat-mode analog).

props.name: stepNumberOverride
props.description: Set on Stepper.StepGroup. Overrides the "Step {n}/{total}" badge numerator (ctx.orderedSteps.indexOf(value) + 1) for non-flat-mode groups. THIS group's raw registration index also counts off-path mutually-exclusive sibling groups registered before it, inflating the numerator past its real path-order position once an off-path sibling renders ahead of an on-path active group (e.g. "Step 5/4"). Omit to fall back to the raw registration index.

props.name: hideStepNumber
props.description: Set on Stepper.StepGroup. When true, this group has no meaningful step-number identity on this run — e.g. an off-path mutually-exclusive sibling group that was never walked (doesn't occur in today's real flows, where StepGroups are fixed and only Steps within a group branch, but the types still allow it). Suppresses the "Step n/total" badge pill, replaces the indicator circle's number with a neutral placeholder, and drops the "Step n of m: " prefix from the aria-label — leaving just the title. Has no effect when showStepBadge is false, since in that case stepNumber is already the plain raw registration index for every group with no override scale to collide with in the first place.

props.name: visualCompleted
props.description: Set on Stepper.Step. Presentation-only: render this step's icon/color as 'completed' regardless of `state`. Does NOT affect accordion-open behavior, which always reflects the real `state`.

props.name: contentOnly
props.description: Set on Stepper.Step. When true, render only the branch wire and panel — no step label row (single-pane accordion cards).

props.name: headerActions
props.description: Set on Stepper.Step. Optional controls rendered in the collapsible step header, immediately left of the expand/collapse caret (e.g. SinglePaneStepper's Restart). Ignored when the step is not collapsible.
